Inside, the paper had curled tight, ink smudged at the edges. It read only: 'If you find this, the light still works. Someone is still watching. Thank you.' No name, no date. That night he wrote a reply, sealed it in the same bottle, and threw it back toward the waves, not expecting anything, just wanting someone out there to know he'd answered.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡的马路上，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划开一道短暂的痕迹。便利店的玻璃窗透出冷白的光，店员靠着柜台打哈欠，货架上的关东煮还冒着热气。远处高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，发出低沉的轰鸣，很快又消失在夜色里。小区里偶尔传来几声狗叫，随后又归于寂静。清洁工推着扫帚车慢慢走过街角，扫帚划过地面的声音在空气中显得格外清晰。天边还未透出一点亮色，整座城市像是在等待一个信号，才肯慢慢醒来。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\nIt keeps doing this, making the problem smaller each time, until it reaches a tiny version it can answer right away, called the base case.\nThen all the small answers get combined on the way back, like a line of dominoes falling and standing back up, to give the final answer."}
